notes: Merged PRs (or a rejected first PR plus its merged replacement) with review history. Offline seating is scored by score_pr.py. Ballot hit/miss is a human/offline judgment against the review invariant, recorded in scorecard.md. Do not treat open issues as ground truth.

cases.text: LICM load_borrow weakly imported global #available speculative hoist
cases.review_invariant: Do not add a weakly-imported special case; load_borrow must not be speculatively hoisted, same as load.

cases.text: LICM do not move scoped instructions out of the loop speculatively load_borrow
cases.review_invariant: Generalize the hoist check to the scoped-instruction class.
Check isRepresentableInLanguage (inferred @objc), not InterfaceTypeRequest; do not use TypeRepr; tests sync and async; limitBehavior/softenIfAccessNote.
Use getFragileFunctionKind(), not a hardcoded attribute list; parameterize the diagnostic on fragile kind.

cases.text: PackageCMO usableFromInline AST mutation conservative CMO
cases.review_invariant: Do not disable makeDeclUsableFromInline for all CMO; package-CMO only. Aggressive CMO still mutates AST by design.

cases.text: CxxPair suppress Copyable noncopyable C++ pair
cases.review_invariant: Suppress Copyable when the imported C++ type is not copyable.

cases.text: Embedded Swift generic protocol requirement witness_method specialize
cases.review_invariant: Do not specialize witness_method when the requirement is ABI-more-generic than the protocol. Shared SIL utility + test/embedded/.
FRT inference through the request evaluator, not a process-global cache. Unique retain/release; diamond inheritance is not inferred FRT.

cases.text: Sendable immutable weak var capture region isolation weak let
cases.review_invariant: RBI must see Sendable immutable weak captures as the isolation the language rule requires; SILIsolationInfo is concurrency, not a drive-by SILBuilder change.

cases.text: embedded specialized witness tables InitExistentialAddr convertIndirectToDirect
cases.review_invariant: Embedded witness specialization of existentials belongs in shared utilities; do not convert-indirect-to-direct when that invents the wrong convention.

cases.text: Hide type metadata records for noncopyable types from discovery by existing runtimes
cases.review_invariant: Noncopyable type metadata must not be discoverable by older runtimes as copyable. Separate section / RuntimeResolvableTypes2.

cases.text: distributed protocol calls witnesses mangling distributed thunk getter
cases.review_invariant: Distributed thunks/getters must mangle and witness as the distributed protocol, not as ordinary accessors.

cases.text: preconcurrency override Any to any Sendable stripConcurrency
cases.review_invariant: @preconcurrency overrides strip concurrency before matching; sendability mismatch is not a hard type failure that also bans mutable overrides.

cases.text: usableFromInline package decls from interface treated as public skip access checks
cases.review_invariant: Package + UFI decls loaded from a public/private interface without package-name are effectively public for access checking.

cases.text: LargeTypesReg2Mem avoid explosion schema very large types compile time
cases.review_invariant: Do not build an explosion schema just to count registers for a very large type; keep it indirect.
